image_description: A close-up shot of an ornate, multi-component necklace displayed on a white mannequin bust. The necklace features a thick, metallic collar-style base with irregular, organic-shaped links in bronze and gold tones. Hanging from the base are several large, spherical pendants resembling marbles or glass beads with internal swirls of color (black/white, cream/brown, pink/green). A central teardrop-shaped amber pendant hangs lower than the rest.
